title: Simple List

illustrates.quote: A list is preceded and followed by a blank line in most situations.

blocks.features: Single-column vertical list, five items, one word per line, no markers or bullets, plain roman lowercase font, left-aligned flush with the paragraph margin.

print.surroundingText: 8.3.2.b/c/d follow, cross-referencing Samples 8-1/8-2/8-3 for blank-line handling around page-change indicators.
print.printFeatures: Boxed illustration; five single words stacked vertically, no bullets or numbers, ordinary roman lowercase, generous blank space above and below inside the box.

braille.notes: Blank line (all 40 cells blank, U+2800) precedes and follows the list per 8.3.2.a; items begin in cell 1 per 8.3.1, each item's braille line is unpadded to the 40-cell width (only the two boundary blank lines are full-width).

resolution: braille.lines byte-identical between A and B; only prose fields differed in wording — A’s kept.
